title: Grateful Dead Live at Ventura County Fairgrounds on 1982-07-18

ai_review.summary: High‑energy “disco‑Dead” show with Jerry on fire, captured on a mostly crisp soundboard that suffers from low‑end loss for some listeners.
ai_review.review: The July 18 1982 Ventura performance is praised for its blistering tempo and a standout Loser solo, with Jerry’s guitar described as “on fire” and Phil’s bass “blowing it up.”  Recording quality is split – many hear A+‑grade clarity, while others note a thin low end and possible tape‑speed issues, making the source technically fair to good.  Overall the show delivers high energy despite the mixed audio fidelity.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is consistently rated very high (multiple 5‑star comments) while recording quality receives both praise and criticism, resulting in an overall rating just above four stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp clarity praised by some reviewers, but many report a severe lack of low‑end and suspect tape‑speed errors; another source is said to “scorch” in comparison.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Fast, upbeat pacing that many fans label a rare “disco‑Dead” treat; the set maintains high momentum throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as “on fire” with an intense solo on Loser; also noted as sounding a bit rough and affected by drug use at this stage.
band_member_comments.Phil: His bass work is highlighted as “blowing it up,” indicating strong performance despite low‑end recording issues.
